command:
set -euo pipefail
D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-mcp-source-test.XXXXXX)
cd "$D"
if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity repo -- --quiet; else git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git repo; fi
cd repo
git fetch -q origin chatgpt/omega-chatgpt-mcp-bridge-20260912
git checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
python3 -m py_compile tools/omega_chatgpt_mcp.py tools/omega_grid_relay.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_chatgpt_mcp.py
printf '\nTEST_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf '\nTEST_DIR='; pwd
